_README.reason: BINARY-BYTE-GATE-1 allowlist. Every entry shields a DELIBERATE control byte found by the 2026-08-15 estate sweep and must carry a written `reason` — an entry without one fails the gate. Ratchet: a listed file may carry at most the listed count of each listed byte, may carry no byte value that is not listed, and an unlisted file must be clean. tools/05-invoice-a2a-suite.html.reason: DELIBERATE, spec-mandated binary data. The raw 0x01 sits inside the 32-byte PDF standard-security-handler padding string (28 BF 4E 5E 4E 75 8A 41 64 00 4E 56 FF FA 01 08 2E 2E 00 B6 D0 68 3E 80 2F 0C A9 FE 64 53 69 7A) in the inlined pdfkit/FPDF encryption code — the source cites foliojs/pdfkit lib/security.js and fpdf.org/en/script/script37.php directly above it. The constant is fixed by the PDF specification: changing any byte of it breaks PDF encryption. Neighbouring bytes of the same constant are written as \0, \b and \f escapes; the minifier emitted this one raw. Never fix, never rewrite.

chaingraph/kernels/__proptests__/_pbt-co.reason: DELIBERATE fuzz corpus. Removing them would silently narrow the property-testing floor. Escaping them would move this file's bytes, which the FV floor digest gates read.
